project: Sumita Gurung · Paila Pilates Studio Interior

calendar.note: Planning choice: Sunday–Friday work, Saturday closed. Daily crew booking assumes a normal full productive shift; shift length and working conditions need contractor agreement. No public holidays or contractor leave have been entered. Relative Day 1 assumes Sunday; set a date to use its actual weekday.

profiles.label: Custom joinery fabrication
profiles.qualification: Quoted frontage area, not sheet area. Assumed 1.5 m² frontage per 2 carpenter +1-helper shop day. Curves, lamination, drawers, hardware and setup can change output. Not an official productivity norm.

profiles.label: Custom joinery
profiles.qualification: Assumed site fitting output on quoted frontage area. Workshop fabrication is scheduled separately; custom dimensions/details must be approved first.

profiles.label: Shoe rack
profiles.qualification: Assumed site fitting output on quoted frontage area. Workshop fabrication is scheduled separately; custom dimensions/details must be approved first.

profiles.label: Marble finish
profiles.qualification: DUDBC H35 proxy:1.4 skilled+1.2 helper wage-days/m² for traditional 15 mm marble on mortar with rubbing/polishing. A 2 stone-worker + 2 helper crew is governed by2/1.4=1.4286 m²/day. Modern slab/adhesive method is unconfirmed; confirm this conservative proxy before commitment.

profiles.label: PVC surface panels
profiles.qualification: DUDBC N27 has 0.8 skilled+0.8 helper per 6m² of prelaminated board on aluminium frame:7.5 m²/one skilled + one helper crew-day. Used only as a qualified framing proxy; PVC and WPC assemblies are not that exact specification.

profiles.label: Framed decorative panels
profiles.qualification: DUDBC N27 has 0.8 skilled+0.8 helper per 6m² of prelaminated board on aluminium frame:7.5 m²/one skilled + one helper crew-day. Used only as a qualified framing proxy; PVC and WPC assemblies are not that exact specification.

profiles.label: Cement-board partition
profiles.qualification: Assumed 10 m² per 2-board-fixer+1-helper crew-day, split35% framing /65% closing and jointing. The published modern board items do not establish an applicable labour coefficient. Curved details and access may reduce production; confirm assembly and quantity faces.

profiles.label: Gypsum / ceiling boards
profiles.qualification: Assumed 10 m² per 2-board-fixer+1-helper crew-day, split35% framing /65% closing and jointing. The published modern board items do not establish an applicable labour coefficient. Curved details and access may reduce production; confirm assembly and quantity faces.

profiles.label: Putty preparation
profiles.qualification: DUDBC I17:1 skilled+1 helper per 10 m² of 2 mm putty. Base10 m² per one painter+one-helper crew-day. Substrate, thickness, preparation and exact quote scope require confirmation.

profiles.label: Primer & first emulsion coat
profiles.qualification: DUDBC J5a primer0.03 skilled+0.03 helper per m², plus half J19 two-coat coefficient0.045+0.025. Skilled input governs 13.333m²/crew-day. Splitting J19 equally between coats is an explicit planning allocation; separate rounding reserves whole workdays.

profiles.label: Final emulsion coat
profiles.qualification: Half of DUDBC J19 two-coat0.09 skilled+0.05 helper/m²:0.045+0.025 per allocated coat. Skilled input governs 22.222m²/crew-day. This is a staged allocation, not a separately published single-coat norm.

profiles.label: Putty, primer & paint
profiles.qualification: Full quoted area is used once for each required stage: putty, primer/first coat, then final coat. Putty-only locker work receives no invented painting stage.

profiles.label: LED strip fittings
profiles.qualification: Assumed 20 running metres/crew-day for specified strip mounting, connections and checks. This is not the concealed point-wiring norm. Cable routes, driver loads and circuit lengths remain unmeasured.

profiles.label: Ceiling / wardrobe light fixtures
profiles.qualification: DWRI2081 item23.14A:0.5 skilled+0.5 semi-skilled person-days per 10 simple fixtures =20fixtures/one electrician + one competent assistant crew-day. Does not include a new wiring circuit or complex support design.

profiles.label: Hanging / chandelier fixtures
profiles.qualification: DWRI23.14B complex-fixture proxy:1 skilled+1 semi-skilled per 10fixtures. One additional handling helper is an explicit assumption for hanging fittings; confirm weight, anchorage and work at height.

profiles.label: Quoted ceiling lighting points
profiles.qualification: The source quotes5 points, not a ceiling area. Reserve one crew-day for those 5 points; definition/overlap with the separately quoted gypsum ceiling must be confirmed. Not a full point-wiring takeoff.

profiles.label: Split AC equipment
profiles.qualification: Assumed one split unit per two technician + one assistant site day;6 quoted units retain source quantities. Concealed routes are a separate provisional first-fix slot. Pipe runs, refrigerant, electrical protection and commissioning method are not designed here.

profiles.label: Kitchen sink & tap
profiles.qualification: Assumed one measured sink/tap connection and leak check per crew-day after counter/support readiness. Existing pipe routes and quantities are not supplied; their first-fix slot is conditional.

profiles.label: Brand signage
profiles.qualification: Planning assumption; obtain a measured supplier method, crew quote and delivery commitment. Low/high are sensitivity factors, not observed market percentiles.

profiles.label: Sofa / couch delivery
profiles.qualification: Supplier fabrication / procurement lead is a 21-calendar-day assumption; quantity-based site activity covers delivery and placement only. Reception couch source unit is blank; quantity 2 is explicitly assumed to mean 2 pieces for this planning activity.

profiles.label: Curtains
profiles.qualification: Assumed 20m² of quoted curtain area per two installer + one assistant day. Fabric area is a proxy for installation, not a measured rail length; supplier measures height, fullness, rails and anchorage before ordering.

profiles.label: Mirrors
profiles.qualification: Assumed 5 m² of framed mirror per 2glazier+1assistant day. The washroom each-item is separately assigned to the mirror-each profile; support, safety glazing, adhesive and cure instructions require approval.

profiles.label: Single decorative mirror
profiles.qualification: Assumed two each-items per 2glazier+1assistant day, rounded to one occupied day for the quoted single mirror. No mirror area is inferred.

profiles.label: Laminate flooring
profiles.qualification: Unmeasured allowance. If an owner-entered area is supplied, assume20m² per 2floor-layers+1helper day; otherwise use the explicit 3-day reserved slot. Product, subfloor, moisture, acclimation and furniture-loading readiness remain unconfirmed.

policy: Six held works stay unscheduled; original prices and quantities are unchanged.
Zero quoted quantity is not an instruction to install.
Low/high outputs are80% /125% sensitivity factors around the base; they are not empirical market ranges.
Whole workdays reserve a complete crew even for small jobs; calculated effort and reserved worker-days differ.
Capacity leveling is a deterministic feasible heuristic, not a proven optimal programme.
The flooring and electrical allowances remain unmeasured. Reserved slots keep a conditional sequence visible, not a complete quantity-derived opening commitment.
No demolition, excavation, RCC, waterproofing, new masonry or extra fixtures are invented from a renovation estimate that does not quantify them.
Daily professional supervision, landlord approvals and test acceptance remain required coordination outside task labour arithmetic.
